purpose: Canonical prep contracts for high-value NFL intelligence feature families. These schemas define evidence shape and PIT rules, not production model weights.

contracts.point_in_time_rule: target timestamp may use only intervals/source evidence observed no later than target information clock
special_rules: coordinator title does not imply playcalling responsibility
ambiguous/overlapping role intervals fail closed
effective_end may be null only for current open interval
contracts.multi_year_rule: retain career history and current-regime identity separately; do not pool regimes as identical

contracts.point_in_time_rule: no current-game snap/route/carry/target observation may enter this row
special_rules: depth rank is not snap projection
postseason-released participation cannot be a current-season live field
missing historical participation remains missing, not zero
replacement hierarchy must be explicit or UNKNOWN
contracts.multi_year_rule: long-term role prior + current-season role + recent-role deviation; reset/shrink on team/scheme/position changes

contracts.point_in_time_rule: append every observation; never overwrite earlier state
special_rules: official inactive is a separate later event
practice status and game status remain separate
identity unresolved -> quarantine
contracts.multi_year_rule: historical progression effects may use audited historical reports; 2026 live uses official prospective captures

contracts.point_in_time_rule: run_initialized_at and observed_at must be strictly before target prediction freeze
special_rules: roof/indoor status gates outdoor exposure
historical reanalysis cannot masquerade as forecast
forecast lead time retained
model version/provider retained
contracts.multi_year_rule: use archived forecast runs where available; older observed weather may support mechanism research only

contracts.point_in_time_rule: history_cutoff strictly precedes target kickoff; target-game snaps forbidden
special_rules: snap count source is completed-game history
2012 coverage must be audited before assuming completeness
contracts.multi_year_rule: test recent, season, trailing-season and career/regime horizons

contracts.point_in_time_rule: claim can affect only targets whose decision freeze is after published_at/observed_at; later edits/corrections append new ledger rows rather than rewrite history
special_rules: separate direct observation, direct quote, sourced report, inference and opinion
speaker or reporter credibility is claim-type specific
postgame claim cannot affect prediction for the completed game
team/coach/player statements are claims, not truth labels
anonymous-source reporting requires lower/default confidence until corroborated
aggregation may not outrank original reporting
contracts.multi_year_rule: prospective-first; historical backfill only where original timestamp and source are recoverable

contracts.point_in_time_rule: only evidence available by detected_at may support the event; realized target-game usage is evaluation data, not detection evidence
special_rules: role change may be injury-driven, performance-driven, depth-chart-driven, scheme-driven or coach-declared
confidence must reflect source mix and agreement
temporary practice rep change is not automatically permanent role change
structural change must be distinguishable from normal weekly variance
contracts.multi_year_rule: change thresholds should be learned by position/regime from multi-year role transitions

contracts.point_in_time_rule: hierarchy uses only depth/roster/prior usage/practice/news/inactive evidence available by information_clock
special_rules: do not assume next listed depth-chart player inherits all usage
committee and cross-position redistribution must be representable
unknown hierarchy remains UNKNOWN
hierarchy prediction must later be scored against realized first-half/full-game role separately
contracts.multi_year_rule: current team/regime evidence dominates; player career usage is a shrinkage prior

contracts.point_in_time_rule: redistribution is predicted before target game; realized usage is grading data only
special_rules: predicted shares must reconcile to coherent team opportunity totals
role redistribution may change total team opportunity as well as shares
routes, targets, carries and scoring-role opportunities are separate budgets
QB/coach/scheme changes may alter redistribution weights
contracts.multi_year_rule: estimate hierarchical redistribution effects from multi-year on/off events with heavy current-regime weighting
